description: Objective jazz-theory questions with a checkable short answer. Model answers JSON {"answer":"..."}; scored by normalized match against accept[]. (b31~ are former F items: external music-theory YouTube benchmark)

items.q: A progression in Bb major is: Bb → G7 → C7 → F. What is the harmonic function of the G7 chord, expressed in Roman numerals?

In the key of E major, the chord G#7 resolves DECEPTIVELY. To which chord does it resolve? (Answer with the chord name.)
The notes A, D, C, F#, and Eb appear together as a chord in the key of Eb major. Identify the chord (full name) and its function in Roman numerals.
accept: five seven flat nine of three

items.q: A scale is spelled: G, A, Bb, C#, D, E, F. Identify this scale by name (or as a mode of a parent scale).
accept: fourth mode of D harmonic minor
